package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class MapLoader {
    public static World load(String absolutePath) {
        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(absolutePath);
        String content = fh.readString("UTF-8");
        return parse(content);
    }

    static World parse(String content) {
        String[] tokens = content.split("\\s+");
        int idx = 0;
        // Skip comments and blank lines? Actually, our tokenizer just splits on whitespace.
        // The format is whitespace-separated tokens, # lines and blank lines ignored.
        // We need a smarter parser.

        // Better: read line by line, skip blank/comment lines, split each line by whitespace
        List<String> toks = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String line : content.split("\\R")) {
            String trimmed = line.trim();
            if (trimmed.isEmpty() || trimmed.startsWith("#")) continue;
            for (String t : trimmed.split("\\s+")) {
                toks.add(t);
            }
        }

        idx = 0;
        int width = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int height = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int px = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int py = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int itemCount = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));

        List<World.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < itemCount; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            int y = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            String name = toks.get(idx++);
            items.add(new World.Item(x, y, name));
        }

        return new World(width, height, px, py, items);
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.ApplicationListener;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;

public class GameListener implements ApplicationListener {
    private final ScriptedMockInput input;
    private final World world;
    private final String transcriptPath;
    private final CountDownLatch doneLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
    private final StringBuilder transcript = new StringBuilder();
    private int turnsProcessed = 0;
    private boolean exiting = false;
    private boolean finalized = false;

    public GameListener(ScriptedMockInput input, World world, String transcriptPath) {
        this.input = input;
        this.world = world;
        this.transcriptPath = transcriptPath;
    }

    public CountDownLatch getDoneLatch() {
        return doneLatch;
    }

    @Override
    public void create() {}

    @Override
    public void render() {
        if (exiting) return;

        input.tick();

        if (!input.hasCommand()) {
            finalize();
            return;
        }

        String cmd = input.currentCommand();
        applyCommand(cmd);
        turnsProcessed++;

        transcript.append("turn=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append(" cmd=").append(cmd)
                  .append(" pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append('\n');

        if ("QUIT".equals(cmd)) {
            finalize();
        }
    }

    private void applyCommand(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": world.tryMove(0, 1); break;
            case "S": world.tryMove(0, -1); break;
            case "E": world.tryMove(1, 0); break;
            case "W": world.tryMove(-1, 0); break;
            case "PICK": world.tryPick(); break;
            case "QUIT": break;
            default: /* unknown - no-op */ break;
        }
    }

    private String formatInventory() {
        List<String> inv = world.getInventory();
        if (inv.isEmpty()) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');
            sb.append(inv.get(i));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private void finalize() {
        if (finalized) return;
        finalized = true;
        exiting = true;

        transcript.append("FINAL pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append(" turns=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append('\n');

        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(transcriptPath);
        fh.writeString(transcript.toString(), false);

        Gdx.app.exit();
    }

    @Override
    public void pause() {}

    @Override
    public void resume() {}

    @Override
    public void dispose() {
        // Safety net: ensure latch is counted down
        doneLatch.countDown();
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.ApplicationListener;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;

public class GameListener implements ApplicationListener {
    private final ScriptedMockInput input;
    private final World world;
    private final String transcriptPath;
    private final CountDownLatch doneLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
    private final StringBuilder transcript = new StringBuilder();
    private int turnsProcessed = 0;
    private boolean exiting = false;
    private boolean finalized = false;

    public GameListener(ScriptedMockInput input, World world, String transcriptPath) {
        this.input = input;
        this.world = world;
        this.transcriptPath = transcriptPath;
    }

    public CountDownLatch getDoneLatch() {
        return doneLatch;
    }

    @Override
    public void create() {}

    @Override
    public void render() {
        if (exiting) return;

        input.tick();

        if (!input.hasCommand()) {
            finalize();
            return;
        }

        String cmd = input.currentCommand();
        applyCommand(cmd);
        turnsProcessed++;

        transcript.append("turn=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append(" cmd=").append(cmd)
                  .append(" pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append('\n');

        if ("QUIT".equals(cmd)) {
            finalize();
        }
    }

    private void applyCommand(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": world.tryMove(0, 1); break;
            case "S": world.tryMove(0, -1); break;
            case "E": world.tryMove(1, 0); break;
            case "W": world.tryMove(-1, 0); break;
            case "PICK": world.tryPick(); break;
            case "QUIT": break;
            default: /* unknown - no-op */ break;
        }
    }

    private String formatInventory() {
        List<String> inv = world.getInventory();
        if (inv.isEmpty()) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');
            sb.append(inv.get(i));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private void finalize() {
        if (finalized) return;
        finalized = true;
        exiting = true;

        transcript.append("FINAL pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append(" turns=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append('\n');

        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(transcriptPath);
        fh.writeString(transcript.toString(), false);

        Gdx.app.exit();
    }

    @Override
    public void pause() {}

    @Override
    public void resume() {}

    @Override
    public void dispose() {
        // Safety net: ensure latch is counted down
        doneLatch.countDown();
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.backends.headless.mock.input.MockInput;
import java.util.List;

public class ScriptedMockInput extends MockInput {
    private final List<String> commands;
    private int cursor = -1;
    private String currentRaw;
    private int currentKey = -1;  // -1 means none

    public ScriptedMockInput(List<String> commands) {
        this.commands = commands;
    }

    public void tick() {
        if (cursor + 1 < commands.size()) {
            cursor++;
            currentRaw = commands.get(cursor);
            currentKey = mapToKey(currentRaw);
        } else {
            currentRaw = null;
            currentKey = -1;
        }
    }

    public boolean hasCommand() {
        return currentRaw != null;
    }

    public String currentCommand() {
        return currentRaw;
    }

    private static int mapToKey(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": return Input.Keys.UP;
            case "S": return Input.Keys.DOWN;
            case "E": return Input.Keys.RIGHT;
            case "W": return Input.Keys.LEFT;
            case "PICK": return Input.Keys.SPACE;
            case "QUIT": return Input.Keys.ESCAPE;
            default: return -1;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isKeyJustPressed(int keycode) {
        return currentKey != -1 && currentKey == keycode;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isKeyPressed(int keycode) {
        return currentKey != -1 && currentKey == keycode;
    }
}

import java.util.ArrayList;

public class World {
    public final int width;
    public final int height;
    public int playerX;
    public int playerY;
    private final List<Item> items;  // in map definition order
    private final List<String> inventory;  // pickup order

    public World(int width, int height, int playerX, int playerY, List<Item> items) {
        this.width = width;
        this.height = height;
        this.playerX = playerX;
        this.playerY = playerY;
        this.items = new ArrayList<>(items);
        this.inventory = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public List<String> getInventory() {
        return inventory;
    }

    public int totalItems() {
        return items.size();
    }

    public boolean tryMove(int dx, int dy) {
        int nx = playerX + dx;
        int ny = playerY + dy;
        if (nx < 0 || nx >= width || ny < 0 || ny >= height) {
            return false;
        }
        playerX = nx;
        playerY = ny;
        return true;
    }

    /** Returns the name of the item picked up, or null if no item was picked. */
    public String tryPick() {
        Iterator<Item> it = items.iterator();
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            Item item = it.next();
            if (item.x == playerX && item.y == playerY) {
                it.remove();
                inventory.add(item.name);
                return item.name;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static class Item {
        public final int x;
        public final int y;
        public final String name;

        public Item(int x, int y, String name) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.name = name;
        }
    }

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class MapLoader {
    public static World load(String absolutePath) {
        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(absolutePath);
        String content = fh.readString("UTF-8");
        return parse(content);
    }

    static World parse(String content) {
        String[] tokens = content.split("\\s+");
        int idx = 0;
        // Skip comments and blank lines? Actually, our tokenizer just splits on whitespace.
        // The format is whitespace-separated tokens, # lines and blank lines ignored.
        // We need a smarter parser.

        // Better: read line by line, skip blank/comment lines, split each line by whitespace
        List<String> toks = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String line : content.split("\\R")) {
            String trimmed = line.trim();
            if (trimmed.isEmpty() || trimmed.startsWith("#")) continue;
            for (String t : trimmed.split("\\s+")) {
                toks.add(t);
            }
        }

        idx = 0;
        int width = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int height = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int px = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int py = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int itemCount = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));

        List<World.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < itemCount; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            int y = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            String name = toks.get(idx++);
            items.add(new World.Item(x, y, name));
        }

        return new World(width, height, px, py, items);
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.ApplicationListener;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;

public class GameListener implements ApplicationListener {
    private final ScriptedMockInput input;
    private final World world;
    private final String transcriptPath;
    private final CountDownLatch doneLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
    private final StringBuilder transcript = new StringBuilder();
    private int turnsProcessed = 0;
    private boolean exiting = false;
    private boolean finalized = false;

    public GameListener(ScriptedMockInput input, World world, String transcriptPath) {
        this.input = input;
        this.world = world;
        this.transcriptPath = transcriptPath;
    }

    public CountDownLatch getDoneLatch() {
        return doneLatch;
    }

    @Override
    public void create() {}

    @Override
    public void render() {
        if (exiting) return;

        input.tick();

        if (!input.hasCommand()) {
            finalize();
            return;
        }

        String cmd = input.currentCommand();
        applyCommand(cmd);
        turnsProcessed++;

        transcript.append("turn=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append(" cmd=").append(cmd)
                  .append(" pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append('\n');

        if ("QUIT".equals(cmd)) {
            finalize();
        }
    }

    private void applyCommand(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": world.tryMove(0, 1); break;
            case "S": world.tryMove(0, -1); break;
            case "E": world.tryMove(1, 0); break;
            case "W": world.tryMove(-1, 0); break;
            case "PICK": world.tryPick(); break;
            case "QUIT": break;
            default: /* unknown - no-op */ break;
        }
    }

    private String formatInventory() {
        List<String> inv = world.getInventory();
        if (inv.isEmpty()) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');
            sb.append(inv.get(i));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private void finalize() {
        if (finalized) return;
        finalized = true;
        exiting = true;

        transcript.append("FINAL pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append(" turns=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append('\n');

        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(transcriptPath);
        fh.writeString(transcript.toString(), false);

        Gdx.app.exit();
    }

    @Override
    public void pause() {}

    @Override
    public void resume() {}

    @Override
    public void dispose() {
        // Safety net: ensure latch is counted down
        doneLatch.countDown();
    }
}

        for (String arg : args) {

                mapPath = arg.substring("--map=".length());
            } else if (arg.startsWith("--commands=")) {
                commandsPath = arg.substring("--commands=".length());
            } else if (arg.startsWith("--transcript=")) {
                transcriptPath = arg.substring("--transcript=".length());
            }

            System.err.println("Usage: --map=<PATH> --commands=<PATH> --transcript=<PATH>");

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.backends.headless.mock.input.MockInput;
import java.util.List;

public class ScriptedMockInput extends MockInput {
    private final List<String> commands;
    private int cursor = -1;
    private String currentRaw;
    private int currentKey = -1;  // -1 means none

    public ScriptedMockInput(List<String> commands) {
        this.commands = commands;
    }

    public void tick() {
        if (cursor + 1 < commands.size()) {
            cursor++;
            currentRaw = commands.get(cursor);
            currentKey = mapToKey(currentRaw);
        } else {
            currentRaw = null;
            currentKey = -1;
        }
    }

    public boolean hasCommand() {
        return currentRaw != null;
    }

    public String currentCommand() {
        return currentRaw;
    }

    private static int mapToKey(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": return Input.Keys.UP;
            case "S": return Input.Keys.DOWN;
            case "E": return Input.Keys.RIGHT;
            case "W": return Input.Keys.LEFT;
            case "PICK": return Input.Keys.SPACE;
            case "QUIT": return Input.Keys.ESCAPE;
            default: return -1;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isKeyJustPressed(int keycode) {
        return currentKey != -1 && currentKey == keycode;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isKeyPressed(int keycode) {
        return currentKey != -1 && currentKey == keycode;
    }
}

import java.util.ArrayList;

import java.util.List;

public class World {
    public final int width;
    public final int height;
    public int playerX;
    public int playerY;
    private final List<Item> items;  // in map definition order
    private final List<String> inventory;  // pickup order

    public World(int width, int height, int playerX, int playerY, List<Item> items) {
        this.width = width;
        this.height = height;
        this.playerX = playerX;
        this.playerY = playerY;
        this.items = new ArrayList<>(items);
        this.inventory = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public List<String> getInventory() {
        return inventory;
    }

    public int totalItems() {
        return items.size();
    }

    public boolean tryMove(int dx, int dy) {
        int nx = playerX + dx;
        int ny = playerY + dy;
        if (nx < 0 || nx >= width || ny < 0 || ny >= height) {
            return false;
        }
        playerX = nx;
        playerY = ny;
        return true;
    }

    /** Returns the name of the item picked up, or null if no item was picked. */
    public String tryPick() {
        Iterator<Item> it = items.iterator();
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            Item item = it.next();
            if (item.x == playerX && item.y == playerY) {
                it.remove();
                inventory.add(item.name);
                return item.name;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static class Item {
        public final int x;
        public final int y;
        public final String name;

        public Item(int x, int y, String name) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.name = name;
        }
    }

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class MapLoader {
    public static World load(String absolutePath) {
        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(absolutePath);
        String content = fh.readString("UTF-8");
        return parse(content);
    }

    static World parse(String content) {
        String[] tokens = content.split("\\s+");
        int idx = 0;
        // Skip comments and blank lines? Actually, our tokenizer just splits on whitespace.
        // The format is whitespace-separated tokens, # lines and blank lines ignored.
        // We need a smarter parser.

        // Better: read line by line, skip blank/comment lines, split each line by whitespace
        List<String> toks = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String line : content.split("\\R")) {
            String trimmed = line.trim();
            if (trimmed.isEmpty() || trimmed.startsWith("#")) continue;
            for (String t : trimmed.split("\\s+")) {
                toks.add(t);
            }
        }

        idx = 0;
        int width = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int height = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int px = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int py = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int itemCount = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));

        List<World.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < itemCount; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            int y = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            String name = toks.get(idx++);
            items.add(new World.Item(x, y, name));
        }

        return new World(width, height, px, py, items);
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.ApplicationListener;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;

public class GameListener implements ApplicationListener {
    private final ScriptedMockInput input;
    private final World world;
    private final String transcriptPath;
    private final CountDownLatch doneLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
    private final StringBuilder transcript = new StringBuilder();
    private int turnsProcessed = 0;
    private boolean exiting = false;
    private boolean finalized = false;

    public GameListener(ScriptedMockInput input, World world, String transcriptPath) {
        this.input = input;
        this.world = world;
        this.transcriptPath = transcriptPath;
    }

    public CountDownLatch getDoneLatch() {
        return doneLatch;
    }

    @Override
    public void create() {}

    @Override
    public void render() {
        if (exiting) return;

        input.tick();

        if (!input.hasCommand()) {
            finalize();
            return;
        }

        String cmd = input.currentCommand();
        applyCommand(cmd);
        turnsProcessed++;

        transcript.append("turn=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append(" cmd=").append(cmd)
                  .append(" pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append('\n');

        if ("QUIT".equals(cmd)) {
            finalize();
        }
    }

    private void applyCommand(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": world.tryMove(0, 1); break;
            case "S": world.tryMove(0, -1); break;
            case "E": world.tryMove(1, 0); break;
            case "W": world.tryMove(-1, 0); break;
            case "PICK": world.tryPick(); break;
            case "QUIT": break;
            default: /* unknown - no-op */ break;
        }
    }

    private String formatInventory() {
        List<String> inv = world.getInventory();
        if (inv.isEmpty()) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');
            sb.append(inv.get(i));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private void finalize() {
        if (finalized) return;
        finalized = true;
        exiting = true;

        transcript.append("FINAL pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append(" turns=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append('\n');

        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(transcriptPath);
        fh.writeString(transcript.toString(), false);

        Gdx.app.exit();
    }

    @Override
    public void pause() {}

    @Override
    public void resume() {}

    @Override
    public void dispose() {
        // Safety net: ensure latch is counted down
        doneLatch.countDown();
    }
}

import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;

import java.util.List;

public class ScriptedMockInput extends MockInput {
    private final List<String> commands;
    private int cursor = -1;
    private String currentRaw;
    private int currentKey = -1;  // -1 means none

    public ScriptedMockInput(List<String> commands) {
        this.commands = commands;
    }

    public void tick() {
        if (cursor + 1 < commands.size()) {
            cursor++;
            currentRaw = commands.get(cursor);
            currentKey = mapToKey(currentRaw);
        } else {
            currentRaw = null;
            currentKey = -1;
        }
    }

        return currentRaw != null;
    }

    public String currentCommand() {
        return currentRaw;

        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": return Input.Keys.UP;
            case "S": return Input.Keys.DOWN;
            case "E": return Input.Keys.RIGHT;
            case "W": return Input.Keys.LEFT;
            case "PICK": return Input.Keys.SPACE;
            case "QUIT": return Input.Keys.ESCAPE;
            default: return -1;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isKeyJustPressed(int keycode) {
        return currentKey != -1 && currentKey == keycode;
    }

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.backends.headless.mock.input.MockInput;
import java.util.List;

public class ScriptedMockInput extends MockInput {
    private final List<String> commands;
    private int cursor = -1;
    private String currentRaw;
    private int currentKey = -1;  // -1 means none

    public ScriptedMockInput(List<String> commands) {
        this.commands = commands;
    }

    public void tick() {
        if (cursor + 1 < commands.size()) {
            cursor++;
            currentRaw = commands.get(cursor);
            currentKey = mapToKey(currentRaw);
        } else {
            currentRaw = null;
            currentKey = -1;
        }
    }

    public boolean hasCommand() {
        return currentRaw != null;
    }

    public String currentCommand() {
        return currentRaw;
    }

    private static int mapToKey(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": return Input.Keys.UP;
            case "S": return Input.Keys.DOWN;
            case "E": return Input.Keys.RIGHT;
            case "W": return Input.Keys.LEFT;
            case "PICK": return Input.Keys.SPACE;
            case "QUIT": return Input.Keys.ESCAPE;
            default: return -1;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isKeyJustPressed(int keycode) {
        return currentKey != -1 && currentKey == keycode;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isKeyPressed(int keycode) {
        return currentKey != -1 && currentKey == keycode;
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.List;

public class World {
    public final int width;
    public final int height;
    public int playerX;
    public int playerY;
    private final List<Item> items;  // in map definition order
    private final List<String> inventory;  // pickup order

    public World(int width, int height, int playerX, int playerY, List<Item> items) {
        this.width = width;
        this.height = height;
        this.playerX = playerX;
        this.playerY = playerY;
        this.items = new ArrayList<>(items);
        this.inventory = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public List<String> getInventory() {
        return inventory;
    }

    public int totalItems() {
        return items.size();
    }

    public boolean tryMove(int dx, int dy) {
        int nx = playerX + dx;
        int ny = playerY + dy;
        if (nx < 0 || nx >= width || ny < 0 || ny >= height) {
            return false;
        }
        playerX = nx;
        playerY = ny;
        return true;
    }

    /** Returns the name of the item picked up, or null if no item was picked. */
    public String tryPick() {
        Iterator<Item> it = items.iterator();
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            Item item = it.next();
            if (item.x == playerX && item.y == playerY) {
                it.remove();
                inventory.add(item.name);
                return item.name;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static class Item {
        public final int x;
        public final int y;
        public final String name;

        public Item(int x, int y, String name) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.name = name;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class MapLoader {
    public static World load(String absolutePath) {
        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(absolutePath);
        String content = fh.readString("UTF-8");
        return parse(content);
    }

    static World parse(String content) {
        String[] tokens = content.split("\\s+");
        int idx = 0;
        // Skip comments and blank lines? Actually, our tokenizer just splits on whitespace.
        // The format is whitespace-separated tokens, # lines and blank lines ignored.
        // We need a smarter parser.

        // Better: read line by line, skip blank/comment lines, split each line by whitespace
        List<String> toks = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String line : content.split("\\R")) {
            String trimmed = line.trim();
            if (trimmed.isEmpty() || trimmed.startsWith("#")) continue;
            for (String t : trimmed.split("\\s+")) {
                toks.add(t);
            }
        }

        idx = 0;
        int width = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int height = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int px = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int py = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int itemCount = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));

        List<World.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < itemCount; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            int y = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            String name = toks.get(idx++);
            items.add(new World.Item(x, y, name));
        }

        return new World(width, height, px, py, items);
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.ApplicationListener;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;

public class GameListener implements ApplicationListener {
    private final ScriptedMockInput input;
    private final World world;
    private final String transcriptPath;
    private final CountDownLatch doneLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
    private final StringBuilder transcript = new StringBuilder();
    private int turnsProcessed = 0;
    private boolean exiting = false;
    private boolean finalized = false;

    public GameListener(ScriptedMockInput input, World world, String transcriptPath) {
        this.input = input;
        this.world = world;
        this.transcriptPath = transcriptPath;
    }

    public CountDownLatch getDoneLatch() {
        return doneLatch;
    }

    @Override
    public void create() {}

    @Override
    public void render() {
        if (exiting) return;

        input.tick();

        if (!input.hasCommand()) {
            finalize();
            return;
        }

        String cmd = input.currentCommand();
        applyCommand(cmd);
        turnsProcessed++;

        transcript.append("turn=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append(" cmd=").append(cmd)
                  .append(" pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append('\n');

        if ("QUIT".equals(cmd)) {
            finalize();
        }
    }

    private void applyCommand(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": world.tryMove(0, 1); break;
            case "S": world.tryMove(0, -1); break;
            case "E": world.tryMove(1, 0); break;
            case "W": world.tryMove(-1, 0); break;
            case "PICK": world.tryPick(); break;
            case "QUIT": break;
            default: /* unknown - no-op */ break;
        }
    }

    private String formatInventory() {
        List<String> inv = world.getInventory();
        if (inv.isEmpty()) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');
            sb.append(inv.get(i));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private void finalize() {
        if (finalized) return;
        finalized = true;
        exiting = true;

        transcript.append("FINAL pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append(" turns=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append('\n');

        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(transcriptPath);
        fh.writeString(transcript.toString(), false);

        Gdx.app.exit();
    }

    @Override
    public void pause() {}

    @Override
    public void resume() {}

    @Override
    public void dispose() {
        // Safety net: ensure latch is counted down
        doneLatch.countDown();
    }
}

    public static World load(String absolutePath) {

        String content = fh.readString("UTF-8");
        return parse(content);

    static World parse(String content) {

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.ApplicationListener;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;

public class GameListener implements ApplicationListener {
    private final ScriptedMockInput input;
    private final World world;
    private final String transcriptPath;
    private final CountDownLatch doneLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
    private final StringBuilder transcript = new StringBuilder();
    private int turnsProcessed = 0;
    private boolean exiting = false;
    private boolean finalized = false;

    public GameListener(ScriptedMockInput input, World world, String transcriptPath) {
        this.input = input;
        this.world = world;
        this.transcriptPath = transcriptPath;
    }

    public CountDownLatch getDoneLatch() {
        return doneLatch;
    }

    @Override
    public void create() {}

    @Override
    public void render() {
        if (exiting) return;

        input.tick();

        if (!input.hasCommand()) {
            finalize();
            return;
        }

        String cmd = input.currentCommand();
        applyCommand(cmd);
        turnsProcessed++;

        transcript.append("turn=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append(" cmd=").append(cmd)
                  .append(" pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append('\n');

        if ("QUIT".equals(cmd)) {
            finalize();
        }
    }

    private void applyCommand(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": world.tryMove(0, 1); break;
            case "S": world.tryMove(0, -1); break;
            case "E": world.tryMove(1, 0); break;
            case "W": world.tryMove(-1, 0); break;
            case "PICK": world.tryPick(); break;
            case "QUIT": break;
            default: /* unknown - no-op */ break;
        }
    }

    private String formatInventory() {
        List<String> inv = world.getInventory();
        if (inv.isEmpty()) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');
            sb.append(inv.get(i));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private void finalize() {
        if (finalized) return;
        finalized = true;
        exiting = true;

        transcript.append("FINAL pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append(" turns=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append('\n');

        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(transcriptPath);
        fh.writeString(transcript.toString(), false);

        Gdx.app.exit();
    }

    @Override
    public void pause() {}

    @Override
    public void resume() {}

    @Override
    public void dispose() {
        // Safety net: ensure latch is counted down
        doneLatch.countDown();
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.backends.headless.mock.input.MockInput;
import java.util.List;

public class ScriptedMockInput extends MockInput {
    private final List<String> commands;
    private int cursor = -1;
    private String currentRaw;
    private int currentKey = -1;  // -1 means none

    public ScriptedMockInput(List<String> commands) {
        this.commands = commands;
    }

    public void tick() {
        if (cursor + 1 < commands.size()) {
            cursor++;
            currentRaw = commands.get(cursor);
            currentKey = mapToKey(currentRaw);
        } else {
            currentRaw = null;
            currentKey = -1;
        }
    }

    public boolean hasCommand() {
        return currentRaw != null;
    }

    public String currentCommand() {
        return currentRaw;
    }

    private static int mapToKey(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": return Input.Keys.UP;
            case "S": return Input.Keys.DOWN;
            case "E": return Input.Keys.RIGHT;
            case "W": return Input.Keys.LEFT;
            case "PICK": return Input.Keys.SPACE;
            case "QUIT": return Input.Keys.ESCAPE;
            default: return -1;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isKeyJustPressed(int keycode) {
        return currentKey != -1 && currentKey == keycode;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isKeyPressed(int keycode) {
        return currentKey != -1 && currentKey == keycode;
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.backends.headless.mock.input.MockInput;
import java.util.List;

public class ScriptedMockInput extends MockInput {
    private final List<String> commands;
    private int cursor = -1;
    private String currentRaw;
    private int currentKey = -1;  // -1 means none

    public ScriptedMockInput(List<String> commands) {
        this.commands = commands;
    }

    public void tick() {
        if (cursor + 1 < commands.size()) {
            cursor++;
            currentRaw = commands.get(cursor);
            currentKey = mapToKey(currentRaw);
        } else {
            currentRaw = null;
            currentKey = -1;
        }
    }

    public boolean hasCommand() {
        return currentRaw != null;
    }

    public String currentCommand() {
        return currentRaw;
    }

    private static int mapToKey(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": return Input.Keys.UP;
            case "S": return Input.Keys.DOWN;
            case "E": return Input.Keys.RIGHT;
            case "W": return Input.Keys.LEFT;
            case "PICK": return Input.Keys.SPACE;
            case "QUIT": return Input.Keys.ESCAPE;
            default: return -1;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isKeyJustPressed(int keycode) {
        return currentKey != -1 && currentKey == keycode;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isKeyPressed(int keycode) {
        return currentKey != -1 && currentKey == keycode;
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import java.util.ArrayList;

import java.util.List;

public class World {
    public final int width;
    public final int height;
    public int playerX;
    public int playerY;
    private final List<Item> items;  // in map definition order
    private final List<String> inventory;  // pickup order

    public World(int width, int height, int playerX, int playerY, List<Item> items) {
        this.width = width;
        this.height = height;
        this.playerX = playerX;
        this.playerY = playerY;
        this.items = new ArrayList<>(items);
        this.inventory = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public List<String> getInventory() {
        return inventory;
    }

    public int totalItems() {
        return items.size();
    }

    public boolean tryMove(int dx, int dy) {
        int nx = playerX + dx;
        int ny = playerY + dy;
        if (nx < 0 || nx >= width || ny < 0 || ny >= height) {
            return false;
        }
        playerX = nx;
        playerY = ny;
        return true;
    }

    /** Returns the name of the item picked up, or null if no item was picked. */
    public String tryPick() {
        Iterator<Item> it = items.iterator();
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            Item item = it.next();
            if (item.x == playerX && item.y == playerY) {
                it.remove();
                inventory.add(item.name);
                return item.name;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static class Item {
        public final int x;
        public final int y;
        public final String name;

        public Item(int x, int y, String name) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.name = name;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class MapLoader {
    public static World load(String absolutePath) {
        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(absolutePath);
        String content = fh.readString("UTF-8");
        return parse(content);
    }

    static World parse(String content) {
        String[] tokens = content.split("\\s+");
        int idx = 0;
        // Skip comments and blank lines? Actually, our tokenizer just splits on whitespace.
        // The format is whitespace-separated tokens, # lines and blank lines ignored.
        // We need a smarter parser.

        // Better: read line by line, skip blank/comment lines, split each line by whitespace
        List<String> toks = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String line : content.split("\\R")) {
            String trimmed = line.trim();
            if (trimmed.isEmpty() || trimmed.startsWith("#")) continue;
            for (String t : trimmed.split("\\s+")) {
                toks.add(t);
            }
        }

        idx = 0;
        int width = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int height = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int px = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int py = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int itemCount = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));

        List<World.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < itemCount; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            int y = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            String name = toks.get(idx++);
            items.add(new World.Item(x, y, name));
        }

        return new World(width, height, px, py, items);
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.ApplicationListener;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;

public class GameListener implements ApplicationListener {
    private final ScriptedMockInput input;
    private final World world;
    private final String transcriptPath;
    private final CountDownLatch doneLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
    private final StringBuilder transcript = new StringBuilder();
    private int turnsProcessed = 0;
    private boolean exiting = false;
    private boolean finalized = false;

    public GameListener(ScriptedMockInput input, World world, String transcriptPath) {
        this.input = input;
        this.world = world;
        this.transcriptPath = transcriptPath;
    }

    public CountDownLatch getDoneLatch() {
        return doneLatch;
    }

    @Override
    public void create() {}

    @Override
    public void render() {
        if (exiting) return;

        input.tick();

        if (!input.hasCommand()) {
            finalize();
            return;
        }

        String cmd = input.currentCommand();
        applyCommand(cmd);
        turnsProcessed++;

        transcript.append("turn=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append(" cmd=").append(cmd)
                  .append(" pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append('\n');

        if ("QUIT".equals(cmd)) {
            finalize();
        }
    }

    private void applyCommand(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": world.tryMove(0, 1); break;
            case "S": world.tryMove(0, -1); break;
            case "E": world.tryMove(1, 0); break;
            case "W": world.tryMove(-1, 0); break;
            case "PICK": world.tryPick(); break;
            case "QUIT": break;
            default: /* unknown - no-op */ break;
        }
    }

    private String formatInventory() {
        List<String> inv = world.getInventory();
        if (inv.isEmpty()) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');
            sb.append(inv.get(i));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private void finalize() {
        if (finalized) return;
        finalized = true;
        exiting = true;

        transcript.append("FINAL pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append(" turns=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append('\n');

        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(transcriptPath);
        fh.writeString(transcript.toString(), false);

        Gdx.app.exit();
    }

    @Override
    public void pause() {}

    @Override
    public void resume() {}

    @Override
    public void dispose() {
        // Safety net: ensure latch is counted down
        doneLatch.countDown();
    }
}

import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class MapLoader {
    public static World load(String absolutePath) {
        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(absolutePath);
        String content = fh.readString("UTF-8");
        return parse(content);
    }

    static World parse(String content) {
        String[] tokens = content.split("\\s+");
        int idx = 0;
        // Skip comments and blank lines? Actually, our tokenizer just splits on whitespace.
        // The format is whitespace-separated tokens, # lines and blank lines ignored.
        // We need a smarter parser.

        // Better: read line by line, skip blank/comment lines, split each line by whitespace
        List<String> toks = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String line : content.split("\\R")) {
            String trimmed = line.trim();
            if (trimmed.isEmpty() || trimmed.startsWith("#")) continue;
            for (String t : trimmed.split("\\s+")) {
                toks.add(t);
            }
        }

        idx = 0;
        int width = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int height = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int px = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int py = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int itemCount = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));

        List<World.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < itemCount; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            int y = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            String name = toks.get(idx++);
            items.add(new World.Item(x, y, name));
        }

        return new World(width, height, px, py, items);
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.ApplicationListener;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;

public class GameListener implements ApplicationListener {
    private final ScriptedMockInput input;
    private final World world;
    private final String transcriptPath;
    private final CountDownLatch doneLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
    private final StringBuilder transcript = new StringBuilder();
    private int turnsProcessed = 0;
    private boolean exiting = false;
    private boolean finalized = false;

    public GameListener(ScriptedMockInput input, World world, String transcriptPath) {
        this.input = input;
        this.world = world;
        this.transcriptPath = transcriptPath;
    }

    public CountDownLatch getDoneLatch() {
        return doneLatch;
    }

    @Override
    public void create() {}

    @Override
    public void render() {
        if (exiting) return;

        input.tick();

        if (!input.hasCommand()) {
            finalize();
            return;
        }

        String cmd = input.currentCommand();
        applyCommand(cmd);
        turnsProcessed++;

        transcript.append("turn=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append(" cmd=").append(cmd)
                  .append(" pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append('\n');

        if ("QUIT".equals(cmd)) {
            finalize();
        }
    }

    private void applyCommand(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": world.tryMove(0, 1); break;
            case "S": world.tryMove(0, -1); break;
            case "E": world.tryMove(1, 0); break;
            case "W": world.tryMove(-1, 0); break;
            case "PICK": world.tryPick(); break;
            case "QUIT": break;
            default: /* unknown - no-op */ break;
        }
    }

    private String formatInventory() {
        List<String> inv = world.getInventory();
        if (inv.isEmpty()) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');
            sb.append(inv.get(i));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private void finalize() {
        if (finalized) return;
        finalized = true;
        exiting = true;

        transcript.append("FINAL pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append(" turns=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append('\n');

        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(transcriptPath);
        fh.writeString(transcript.toString(), false);

        Gdx.app.exit();
    }

    @Override
    public void pause() {}

    @Override
    public void resume() {}

    @Override
    public void dispose() {
        // Safety net: ensure latch is counted down
        doneLatch.countDown();
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.backends.headless.mock.input.MockInput;
import java.util.List;

public class ScriptedMockInput extends MockInput {
    private final List<String> commands;
    private int cursor = -1;
    private String currentRaw;
    private int currentKey = -1;  // -1 means none

    public ScriptedMockInput(List<String> commands) {
        this.commands = commands;
    }

    public void tick() {
        if (cursor + 1 < commands.size()) {
            cursor++;
            currentRaw = commands.get(cursor);
            currentKey = mapToKey(currentRaw);
        } else {
            currentRaw = null;
            currentKey = -1;
        }
    }

    public boolean hasCommand() {
        return currentRaw != null;
    }

    public String currentCommand() {
        return currentRaw;
    }

    private static int mapToKey(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": return Input.Keys.UP;
            case "S": return Input.Keys.DOWN;
            case "E": return Input.Keys.RIGHT;
            case "W": return Input.Keys.LEFT;
            case "PICK": return Input.Keys.SPACE;
            case "QUIT": return Input.Keys.ESCAPE;
            default: return -1;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isKeyJustPressed(int keycode) {
        return currentKey != -1 && currentKey == keycode;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isKeyPressed(int keycode) {
        return currentKey != -1 && currentKey == keycode;
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.backends.headless.mock.input.MockInput;
import java.util.List;

public class ScriptedMockInput extends MockInput {
    private final List<String> commands;
    private int cursor = -1;
    private String currentRaw;
    private int currentKey = -1;  // -1 means none

    public ScriptedMockInput(List<String> commands) {
        this.commands = commands;
    }

    public void tick() {
        if (cursor + 1 < commands.size()) {
            cursor++;
            currentRaw = commands.get(cursor);
            currentKey = mapToKey(currentRaw);
        } else {
            currentRaw = null;
            currentKey = -1;
        }
    }

    public boolean hasCommand() {
        return currentRaw != null;
    }

    public String currentCommand() {
        return currentRaw;
    }

    private static int mapToKey(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": return Input.Keys.UP;
            case "S": return Input.Keys.DOWN;
            case "E": return Input.Keys.RIGHT;
            case "W": return Input.Keys.LEFT;
            case "PICK": return Input.Keys.SPACE;
            case "QUIT": return Input.Keys.ESCAPE;
            default: return -1;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isKeyJustPressed(int keycode) {
        return currentKey != -1 && currentKey == keycode;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isKeyPressed(int keycode) {
        return currentKey != -1 && currentKey == keycode;
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.List;

public class World {
    public final int width;
    public final int height;
    public int playerX;
    public int playerY;
    private final List<Item> items;  // in map definition order
    private final List<String> inventory;  // pickup order

    public World(int width, int height, int playerX, int playerY, List<Item> items) {
        this.width = width;
        this.height = height;
        this.playerX = playerX;
        this.playerY = playerY;
        this.items = new ArrayList<>(items);
        this.inventory = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public List<String> getInventory() {
        return inventory;
    }

    public int totalItems() {
        return items.size();
    }

    public boolean tryMove(int dx, int dy) {
        int nx = playerX + dx;
        int ny = playerY + dy;
        if (nx < 0 || nx >= width || ny < 0 || ny >= height) {
            return false;
        }
        playerX = nx;
        playerY = ny;
        return true;
    }

    /** Returns the name of the item picked up, or null if no item was picked. */
    public String tryPick() {
        Iterator<Item> it = items.iterator();
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            Item item = it.next();
            if (item.x == playerX && item.y == playerY) {
                it.remove();
                inventory.add(item.name);
                return item.name;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static class Item {
        public final int x;
        public final int y;
        public final String name;

        public Item(int x, int y, String name) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.name = name;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class MapLoader {
    public static World load(String absolutePath) {
        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(absolutePath);
        String content = fh.readString("UTF-8");
        return parse(content);
    }

    static World parse(String content) {
        String[] tokens = content.split("\\s+");
        int idx = 0;
        // Skip comments and blank lines? Actually, our tokenizer just splits on whitespace.
        // The format is whitespace-separated tokens, # lines and blank lines ignored.
        // We need a smarter parser.

        // Better: read line by line, skip blank/comment lines, split each line by whitespace
        List<String> toks = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String line : content.split("\\R")) {
            String trimmed = line.trim();
            if (trimmed.isEmpty() || trimmed.startsWith("#")) continue;
            for (String t : trimmed.split("\\s+")) {
                toks.add(t);
            }
        }

        idx = 0;
        int width = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int height = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int px = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int py = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int itemCount = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));

        List<World.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < itemCount; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            int y = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            String name = toks.get(idx++);
            items.add(new World.Item(x, y, name));
        }

        return new World(width, height, px, py, items);
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.ApplicationListener;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;

public class GameListener implements ApplicationListener {
    private final ScriptedMockInput input;
    private final World world;
    private final String transcriptPath;
    private final CountDownLatch doneLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
    private final StringBuilder transcript = new StringBuilder();
    private int turnsProcessed = 0;
    private boolean exiting = false;
    private boolean finalized = false;

    public GameListener(ScriptedMockInput input, World world, String transcriptPath) {
        this.input = input;
        this.world = world;
        this.transcriptPath = transcriptPath;
    }

    public CountDownLatch getDoneLatch() {
        return doneLatch;
    }

    @Override
    public void create() {}

    @Override
    public void render() {
        if (exiting) return;

        input.tick();

        if (!input.hasCommand()) {
            finalize();
            return;
        }

        String cmd = input.currentCommand();
        applyCommand(cmd);
        turnsProcessed++;

        transcript.append("turn=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append(" cmd=").append(cmd)
                  .append(" pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append('\n');

        if ("QUIT".equals(cmd)) {
            finalize();
        }
    }

    private void applyCommand(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": world.tryMove(0, 1); break;
            case "S": world.tryMove(0, -1); break;
            case "E": world.tryMove(1, 0); break;
            case "W": world.tryMove(-1, 0); break;
            case "PICK": world.tryPick(); break;
            case "QUIT": break;
            default: /* unknown - no-op */ break;
        }
    }

    private String formatInventory() {
        List<String> inv = world.getInventory();
        if (inv.isEmpty()) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');
            sb.append(inv.get(i));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private void finalize() {
        if (finalized) return;
        finalized = true;
        exiting = true;

        transcript.append("FINAL pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append(" turns=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append('\n');

        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(transcriptPath);
        fh.writeString(transcript.toString(), false);

        Gdx.app.exit();
    }

    @Override
    public void pause() {}

    @Override
    public void resume() {}

    @Override
    public void dispose() {
        // Safety net: ensure latch is counted down
        doneLatch.countDown();
    }
}

import java.util.ArrayList;

public class World {
    public final int width;
    public final int height;
    public int playerX;
    public int playerY;
    private final List<Item> items;  // in map definition order
    private final List<String> inventory;  // pickup order

    public World(int width, int height, int playerX, int playerY, List<Item> items) {
        this.width = width;
        this.height = height;
        this.playerX = playerX;
        this.playerY = playerY;
        this.items = new ArrayList<>(items);
        this.inventory = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public List<String> getInventory() {
        return inventory;
    }

    public int totalItems() {
        return items.size();
    }

    public boolean tryMove(int dx, int dy) {
        int nx = playerX + dx;
        int ny = playerY + dy;
        if (nx < 0 || nx >= width || ny < 0 || ny >= height) {
            return false;
        }
        playerX = nx;
        playerY = ny;
        return true;
    }

    /** Returns the name of the item picked up, or null if no item was picked. */
    public String tryPick() {
        Iterator<Item> it = items.iterator();
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            Item item = it.next();
            if (item.x == playerX && item.y == playerY) {
                it.remove();
                inventory.add(item.name);
                return item.name;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static class Item {
        public final int x;
        public final int y;
        public final String name;

        public Item(int x, int y, String name) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.name = name;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class MapLoader {
    public static World load(String absolutePath) {
        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(absolutePath);
        String content = fh.readString("UTF-8");
        return parse(content);
    }

    static World parse(String content) {
        String[] tokens = content.split("\\s+");
        int idx = 0;
        // Skip comments and blank lines? Actually, our tokenizer just splits on whitespace.
        // The format is whitespace-separated tokens, # lines and blank lines ignored.
        // We need a smarter parser.

        // Better: read line by line, skip blank/comment lines, split each line by whitespace
        List<String> toks = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String line : content.split("\\R")) {
            String trimmed = line.trim();
            if (trimmed.isEmpty() || trimmed.startsWith("#")) continue;
            for (String t : trimmed.split("\\s+")) {
                toks.add(t);
            }
        }

        idx = 0;
        int width = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int height = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int px = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int py = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
        int itemCount = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));

        List<World.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < itemCount; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            int y = Integer.parseInt(toks.get(idx++));
            String name = toks.get(idx++);
            items.add(new World.Item(x, y, name));
        }

        return new World(width, height, px, py, items);
    }
}

package com.example.turnbased.core;

import com.badlogic.gdx.ApplicationListener;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Gdx;
import com.badlogic.gdx.Input;
import com.badlogic.gdx.files.FileHandle;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;

public class GameListener implements ApplicationListener {
    private final ScriptedMockInput input;
    private final World world;
    private final String transcriptPath;
    private final CountDownLatch doneLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
    private final StringBuilder transcript = new StringBuilder();
    private int turnsProcessed = 0;
    private boolean exiting = false;
    private boolean finalized = false;

    public GameListener(ScriptedMockInput input, World world, String transcriptPath) {
        this.input = input;
        this.world = world;
        this.transcriptPath = transcriptPath;
    }

    public CountDownLatch getDoneLatch() {
        return doneLatch;
    }

    @Override
    public void create() {}

    @Override
    public void render() {
        if (exiting) return;

        input.tick();

        if (!input.hasCommand()) {
            finalize();
            return;
        }

        String cmd = input.currentCommand();
        applyCommand(cmd);
        turnsProcessed++;

        transcript.append("turn=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append(" cmd=").append(cmd)
                  .append(" pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append('\n');

        if ("QUIT".equals(cmd)) {
            finalize();
        }
    }

    private void applyCommand(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "N": world.tryMove(0, 1); break;
            case "S": world.tryMove(0, -1); break;
            case "E": world.tryMove(1, 0); break;
            case "W": world.tryMove(-1, 0); break;
            case "PICK": world.tryPick(); break;
            case "QUIT": break;
            default: /* unknown - no-op */ break;
        }
    }

    private String formatInventory() {
        List<String> inv = world.getInventory();
        if (inv.isEmpty()) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');
            sb.append(inv.get(i));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private void finalize() {
        if (finalized) return;
        finalized = true;
        exiting = true;

        transcript.append("FINAL pos=").append(world.playerX).append(",").append(world.playerY)
                  .append(" inv=").append(formatInventory())
                  .append(" turns=").append(turnsProcessed)
                  .append('\n');

        FileHandle fh = Gdx.files.absolute(transcriptPath);
        fh.writeString(transcript.toString(), false);

        Gdx.app.exit();
    }

    @Override
    public void pause() {}

    @Override
    public void resume() {}

    @Override
    public void dispose() {
        // Safety net: ensure latch is counted down
        doneLatch.countDown();
    }
}
